data.titulo: Onthele 4—Tunde Pohamba Yotete yo Isilayeli alo Poukonde Mombambilonia
data.contenido:
Ohamba yotete yo Isilayeli ankho o Saulu. Mahi, Yehova emuyale, iya aholovona David opo apinge pu Saulu. Matukelilongesa ovipuka ovinyingi kombinga ya David. Etyi ankho David omukuendye waluisile Goliya, elume limue enene. Konyima aende nkholo, mokonda yohamba Saulu yemulingila onkhi. Onthiki imue Abigail omukai umue omuwa, watyilikile David okulinga otyipuka tyimue otyivi.

Konyima yotyo, matukelilongesa ovipuka ovinyingi kombinga ya Salomau omona wa David. Una wapingile pomphangu ya David ngo hamba yova Isilayeli. Onohamba ononthatu mbotete mbova Isilayali, kese imue yatumina omanima 40. Iya konyima yononkhia mba Salomau, o Isilayeli yayapulwa omauhamba evali, wokokulio kuekumbi, no wokokumbili kuekumbi.

Ouhamba womihoko 10, wakalele omanima 257, konyima auhanyaunuapo nova Asiria. Etyi papita omanima 133, ouhamba womihoko vivali, nao auhanyaunuapo. Iya Ovaisilayeli avatualwa koukonde Kombambilonia. Ngotyo, Onthele ya KUANA ina ehipululo liomanima 510. Mokuenda kuomuvo oo, kuapita ovipuka ovinyingi vilunda omutima, ngetyi matukatala.

SAMUELE umueete, ukahi nokutila omulela pomutwe womulume ou? Etyi ankho otyo tyilingwa, pala okulekesa okuti omunthu oo waholovonua opo akale ohamba. Yehova wapopila Samuele atile omulela pomutwe wa Saulu. Ankho omulela oo, wakolela unene nokuanika nawa.

Saulu ankho usoka okuti kafuilepo pala okukala ohamba. Apopila Samuele okuti: ‘Ame ndyi womuhoko wa Benjamim. Omuhoko umue omututu unene mo Isilayeli. Omokonda yatyi upopila okuti mandyilingi ohamba?’ Yehova ankho uhole Saulu. Mokonda ankho Saulu kahande okulipaka kounene. Otyo Huku emukoyela opo akale ohamba.

Mahi, Saulu ankho kahepele. Tupu ankho hamulumeko omututu. Saulu watunda mombunga imue yovahona. Ankho omulume omule, omuwa unene. Saulu ankho omule vali tyipona ovanthu aveho mo Isilayeli. Ankho omulume umue wapama unene. Tupu ankho uhateka unene. Ovanthu avahambukwa unene, etyi Yehova aholovona Saulu opo akale ohamba yavo. Ovanthu aveho avahimbika okutwa ondolo okuti: ‘Alililili ohamba Saulu!’

Onondyale mbova Isilayeli vatualeleko okukala tyapama. Ankho nkhele vamonesa ova Isilayeli ononkhumbi. Iya etyi Saulu alinga ohamba, ovanthu voko Amom, aveiya okulwisa ova Isilayeli. Mahi, Saulu apongiya ovalume ovanyingi vovita, iya avafindi onondyale mbavo. Ovanthu avahambukwa unene etyi Saulu alinga ohamba yavo.

Mokuenda kuomanima, Saulu wakuatesako ova Isilayeli okufinda onondyale mbavo ovikando ovinyingi. Tupu Saulu ankho una omona umue wakola omutima utiwa o Jonatã. Iya Jonatã akuatesako ova Isilayeli okufinda ovita ovinyingi. Ova Filisteu ankho onondyale ononene mbova Isilayeli. Onthiki imue omafualali omanyingi ova Filisteu, aeya okulwisa ova Isilayeli.

Samuele wapopila Saulu emukevelele alo ehika, opo valingile Yehova otyilikutila. Mahi, Samuele ankho ukahi nokuseta. Iya Saulu akala nouoma wokuti ova Filisteu mavahimbika ovilwa. Moluotyo, Saulu alingi otyilikutila aike. Etyi Samuele ehika, apopila Saulu okuti: kuetavelele ku Yehova. Moluotyo, ‘Yehova maholovona omunthu omukuavo opo akale ohamba yova Isilayeli.’

Konyima yotyo, Saulu alingi vali onkhali onkhuavo. Samuele emupopila okuti: ‘Hahe okutavela ku Yehova, tyipona okumulingila otyilikutila nongi yanina. Mokonda kuetavelele ku Yehova, nae kamekuyeke utualeko okukala ohamba yova Isilayeli.’

Oko tupondola okupolako elongeso limue eewa. Otyo tyilekesa okuti okutavela apeho ku Yehova tyakolela unene. Tupu, tyilekesa okuti omunthu wondalawa, ngetyi Saulu ali potete upondola okupiluluka, akala ondingavivi. Onthue katuhande okukala onondingavivi. Ine tuhanda?1 Samuel okapitulu 9 alo 11;13:5-14;14:47-52;15:1-35;2 Samuel 1:23. Omapulo

WEETE oityi tyapita polutalatu apa? Omukuendye ou wayovola ongiona yae kehunyu. Ehunyu ankho liatyindapo ongiona opo likalie. Mahi, omukuendye ou wahatekelamo, ayovolako ongiona yae. Etyi ehunyu liapiluluka omukuendye eliipaa. Onthiki onkhuavo, ayovola ongiona onkhuavo konkheyama. Omukuendye ou, kakolele omutima? Enyina liae ulii?

Omukuendye ou utiwa o David. Ankho ukala mepundaumbo lio Mbelei. Tate mbuale yae o Obede, omona wa Rute na Mboaz. Uvehinangela? Tate ya David o Jesse. David ankho omunthita wonongi mba tate yae. David watyitua etyi papita omanima 10, tunde puetyi Yehova aholovona Saulu opo akale ohamba.

Onthiki imue Yehova wapopila Samuele okuti: ‘Pola omulela wakolela, enda keumbo lia Jesse mo Mbelei. Mokonda povana vae, Ame naholovonapo wike opo akale ohamba.’ Etyi Samuele amona otyiveli tya Jesse Eliabe, asoko okuti: ‘Ou, oe yatyo waholovonwa na Yehova.’ Anthi, Yehova emutolela okuti: ‘Wehemutale vala etyi omule, netyi omuwa. Ame hemokoyele opo akale ohamba.’

Jesse aihana omona wae Abinadabe, emueeta ku Samuele. Mahi, Samuele ati: ‘Au, ou haeko Yehova aholovona.’ Iya Jesse aeta vali omona wae Samá. Samuele ati: ‘Tupu ou haeko waholovonua na Yehova.’ Jesse aeta ovana vae aveho epanduvali ku Samuele. Mahi, Yehova kakoyelepo nawike. Iya Samuel apulu okuti: ‘Ovana vove ovo vala ava?’

Jesse akumbulula okuti: ‘Nkhele pena omututu watyo. Mahi, kepo wakalisa onongi.’ Etyi David eya, Samuele wamona okuti omukuendye umue omuwa. Yehova ati: ‘Oe yatyo ou naholovona. Tila omulela pomutwe wae.’ Iya Samuele alingi ngetyi Yehova emutuma. Etyi omuvo wehikapo, David akala ohamba yova Isilayeli.1 Samuel 17:34, 35; 16:1-13. Omapulo

OVA Filisteu ankho veya vali okulwisa ova Isilayeli. Ovakulu va David vetatu ankho omasualali a Saulu. Onthiki imue Jesse watolela David okuti: ‘Pola okulia no nombolo utuaile ovakulu vove. Otale oñgeni vekahi.’

Etyi David ehika pokapamendu komafualali, akahatekela komutete womasualali ankho elipongiya pala okulwa. Opo akaovole ovakulu vae. Goliya omu Filisteu umue omunene ankho weya okulinga omukuele ova Isilayeli. Omulume oo ankho ulinga ngotyo ononthiki ambuho, komuhuka no kekumbi. Wetyilinga ononthiki 40. Ankho upopia peulu okuti: ‘Holovonei omulume umue eye okulwa naame. Inkha amandyipaa, onthue matukala ovapika venyi. Mahi, inkha ame nemuipaa, onue mamulingi ovapika vetu. Ndyimuleva umue okuti holovonei omulume eye okulwa naame.’ David apulu kesualali limue okuti: ‘Omunthu maipaa omu Filisteu oo, nokuyovola ova Isilayeli molukundo olu, oityi mafetwa?’

Esualali aliti: Saulu memupe emona enyingi. Tupu memuavela omona wae omuhikuena opo alinge omukai wae.’

Mahi, ova Isilayeli aveho ankho vena ouoma na Goliya, mokonda ankho omunene unene. Tupu ankho omule unene. Ankho una onometulu o 3. Tupu ankho una efualali ekuavo limutyindilako otyiyakulilo tyae.

Omasualali amue aakapopila Ohamba Saulu, okuti David wahanda okukalwa na Goliya. Anthi, Saul atolela David ati: ‘Ove kupondola okulwisa omu Filisteu oo. Umona omututu. Omu Filisteu oo, efualali tunde kohale.’ David akumbulula okuti: ‘Ame naipaa ehunyu nonkheyama, ankho viahandele okulia onongi mba tate. Iya omu Filisteu oo, ndyikemuipaa vala ngetyi nai-​paa omanyama oo. Yehova ma-​nkhuatesako.’ Moluotyo, Saulu ati: ‘Enda, Yehova ekukuateseko.’

David walauka pokandongi kamue, akoyopo omamanya etano ekahi nawa, eepake mokasako kae. Apolo otyifuta tyae, aende okukelivasa nomulume oo omunene. Etyi Goliya emumona ahimbika okuyola. Ankho Goliya wasoka okuti katyipuiya okuipaa David.

Goliya ati: ‘Endyu vala kuno. Ohitu yove hono mandyiave koviila no kovinyama opo vilie.’ Anthi, David ati: ‘Ove ukahi nokuiya kuame nomutunga, neo-​nga. Mahi, ame ndyikahi noku-iya kuove menyina lia Yehova. Onthiki yohono Yehova mekuave pomaoko ange, iya ame mandyi-​kuipaa.’

Ngotyo, David akahateka noku Goliya. Apolo emanya mokasako kae, elipake motyifuta, iya eliyumbu no nonkhono mbae ambuho. Emanya olio alikaveta mombamba ya Goliya. Goliya atokela pohi, iya ankhi. Etyi ova Filisteu vamona okuti onkhalamutue yavo yankhia, aveho avahimbika okukahateka. Ova Isilayeli avahatekela monyima yavo, iya avafindi ovita.1 Samuel 17:1-54. Omapulo

ETYI David aipaa Goliya, Abner onkhalamutue yomasualali ova Isilayeli emutuala ku Saulu. Saulu ahambukwa unene na David. Alingi David onkhalamutue yomasualali ae. Iya aende nae opo akakale kombala yae.

Onthiki imue, etyi omasualali akondoka kokuluisa ova Filisteu, ovakai vahimbika okuimba okuti: ‘Saulu waipaa omakwi ovityita. Mahi, David waipaa omakwi nomakwi ovityita.’ Otyo tyaetesa Saulu onkhi, mokonda David ankho ukahi nokuhivilikwa vali tyipona Saulu. Anthi, omona wa Saulu Jonatã ankho utupu onkhi. Jonatã ankho uhole unene David. Iya David ankho nae uhole unene Jonatã. Moluotyo, Jonatã na David valinga omphango yokuti mava-​kala omapanga apeho. David ankho omuhiki omuwa wo harpa. Iya Saulu ankho uhole oviimbo viae. Mahi, onthiki imue onkhi ya Saulu yemulingisa otyipuka tyimue otyivi unene. Puetyi ankho David ahika o harpa, Saulu wapola eonga liae, eliyumbu David ati: ‘Mandyimupapela motyimato.’ Anthi, David wayepa, iya eonga alimuponyo. Onthiki onkhuavo, Saulu waponya vali David neonga liae. Ngotyo, David anoñgonoka okuti una yokulunguka unene.

Uhinangela omulao Saulu alingile? Saulu watile omulume maipaa Goliya, memupe omona wae opo akale omukai wae. Ngotyo, Saulu watolela David okuti memuavela omona wae Mikal. Mahi, tete una yokuipaa vali ova Filisteu 100. Nkhele tyisokolola vala otyo! Tyotyili Saulu ankho wahandele David akaipawe nova Filisteu. Anthi, kavemuipaele, iya Saulu aave omona wae ku David opo alinge omukai wae.

Onthiki imue Saulu wapopila Jonatã novaundapi vae aveho okuti mahande okuipaa David. Mahi, Jonatã atolela tate yae okuti: ‘Wahaipae David, kekulingile natyimue otyivi. Mahi, ovipuka aviho David alinga viekukuatesako unene. David watuaile omuenyo wae motyiponga, opo akaipae Goliya. Etyi emuipaa ove ohambukwa.’

Saulu etavela komona wae Jonatã, alae okuti kamaipaa David. Iya David akondoka okuundapela vali Saulu mondyuo yae. Mahi, onthiki imue, etyi David ankho ahika o harpa, Saulu ayumbu vali David eonga. David wayepa, iya eonga alikatoma motyimato. Otyo otyikando tya tatu. David anoñgonoka okuti pahe una yokutila.

Otyinthiki otyo David aende nokeumbo liae. Mahi, Saulu atumu ovalume vamue opo vekemuipae. Mikal ankho utyii okuti tate yae mahande okumuipaa. Moluotyo, wapopila omulume wae okuti: ‘Inkha kutili otyinthiki tyino, muhuka moipawa.’ Iya kounthiki watyo oo, Mikal akuatesako omulume wae okutila, emupitisa pondyanena. Mokuenda kuomanima epanduvali David ankho uhimama vala nokuholama, opo Saulu ehemuvase.1 Samuel 18:1-30; 19:1-18. Omapulo

OMUKAI ou omuwa uhonyena na David umuii? Enyina liae o Abigail. Ankho omukai umue wokuna onondunge. Watyilikile David okukalinga otyipuka tyimue otyivi. Mahi, putyina nkhele tuhenelilongese kombinga yotyo, tutalei oityi tyapita na David.

Etyi David atila Saulu wakaholamene meleva. Ovakulu vae nombunga yae aiho avemulandula, iya avelipake kumue nae. Ankho vali 400 viovalume, iya David alingi onkhalamutue yavo. David akaita ko hamba yo Moabe okuti: ‘Mbambavo yeka tate yange na me yange, vakale noove alo ndyitala oityi matyipiti naame.’ David novalume vae avahimbika okuholama monomphunda.

Konyima yotyo, David elivasi na Abigail. Omulume wa Abigail Nabal, ankho omuhona. Ankho una onongi 3.000 no vikombo 1.000. Nabal ankho ondingavivi. Mahi, omukai wae Abigail ankho omuwa unene. Tupu ankho utyii okulinga etyi tyaviuka. Onthiki imue ayovola ombunga yae. Tutalei oñgeni.

David novalume vae valekesa Nabal eholelo. Vemukuatesako okuyunga onongi mbae. Ngotyo, onthiki imue David watuma ovalume vae opo vakaite ekuateso ku Nabal. Ovalume va David vavasa Nabal novaundapi vae, ankho vekahi nokuteta onongi omainya. Nabal ankho una ovipuka ovinyingi viokulia. Mokonda ankho onthiki yotyipito. Iya ovalume va David avati: ‘Onthue tuekulekesa eholelo. Ponongi mbove katuavakelepo naike. Anthi, tuekukuatesako okumbuyunga nawa. Pahe mbambavo, tuavelevo okulia.’

Nabal ati: ‘Ame hiavela okulia kuange ovanthu ngonue. Nabal apopi nokhalelo imue ombi. Apopi ovipuka ovivi kombinga ya David. Etyi ovalume ovo vakondoka ku David, avemutolela ovipuka ovio aviho. David anumana unene. Iya apopila ovalume vae ati: ‘Manekei omitunga vienyi.’ Iya avahimbika okuenda opo vakaipae Nabal novaumbili vae.

Omulume umue povaundapi va Nabal, ankho weiva onondaka onombi Nabal apopia, eketyipopia ku Abigail. Abigail akanyauka okupongiya ovikulia. Evipake kovimbulu, iya elipake mondyila. Etyi ahonyena na David, Abigail atuluka kotyimbulu tyae, anyongeka omutue iya apopila David okuti: ‘Mbambavo tatekulu, wahatehelele omulume wange Nabal. Utupu onondunge, walinga ovipuka vioulai. Otyiawa tyove otyetyi. Mbambavo tambula, iya tuevele kombinga yetyi tyapopia Nabal.’

David akumbulula okuti: ‘Ove umukai umue wonondunge. Wanthyilika okukaipaa Nabal, mokonda youvi wae. Pahe kondoka keumbo nombembwa.’ Konyima, etyi Nabal ankhia Abigail alingi omukai wa David.1 Samuel 22:1-4; 25:1-43. Omapulo

SAULU ankho ukahi noku-​ovola vali okukuata David. Wapongiya omafualali 3.000 okuapama vali, aende okukaovola David. Etyi David etyiiva, watuma ovanthu vakalave apa Saulu novalume vae mavakalela. Konyima yotyo, David apulu ovalume vae vevali okuti: ‘Olie maende naame pokapamendu ka Saulu?’

Abisai ati: ‘Ame.’ Abisai ankho omona wa Zeruia omphange ya David. Puetyi Saulu no valume vae ankho velele, David na Abisai aveliyombeleka mokapamendu kavo. Iya avapolopo eonga lia Saulu no katenda kae komeva, ankho vikahi komitwe via Saulu. Nawike wevemona ni okuveiva, mokonda ankho aveho velele.

Pahe tala David na Abisai. Vahupa avalondo komphunda. David pahe ukahi nokuihana onkhalamutue yomafualali ova Isilayeli ukahi pombuelo, okuti: ‘Ove Abener, omokonda yatyi wahayungilile ohamba? Pahe tala! Eonga liae no katenda kae komaande vilipi?’

Saulu apahukapo, aimbuka ondaka ya David, iya apulu okuti: ‘Ove David?’ Saulu na Abener uveete pombuelo apa?

David akumbulula Saulu ati: ‘Enga, ame yatyo. Iya David apulu okuti: ‘Omokonda yatyi uhandela okundyipaa? Otyityi otyivi nekulinga Hamba? Eonga liove olieli. Tuma omulume umwe eye elipole.’ Saulu ati: ‘Ame nalinga otyipuka otyivi. Nalinga o wova.’ Ngotyo David waya nondyila yae, iya Saulu akondoka keumbo. Mahi, David wasoka okuti: ‘Onthiki imue Saulu mandyipaa. Mandyitilila kotyilongo tyova Filisteu.’ Iya ngatyo alinga. David akembelapo ova Filisteu okuti ankho pahe waama konthele yavo. Iya ova Filisteu avetavela.

Onthiki imue, ova Filisteu vaya okukaluisa ova Isilayeli. Saulu na Jonatã avaipawa movita ovio. Otyo tyanumanesa unene David, iya ahoneka otyiimbo tyimue otyiwa ati: ‘Nanumana unene mokonda yove, mukuatate wange Jonatã. Ankho ndyikuhole unene.’

Konyima yotyo, David akondoka ko Isilayeli, kepundaumbo lio Hebron. Ko Hebron ankho kuna ovilwa, pokati kovalume vana ankho vaholovona Isbosete omona wa Saulu, opo akale ohamba. Navana ankho vahanda David alinge ohamba. Mahi, konyima ovalume va David avafindi. David ankho una omanima 30, puetyi alinga ohamba. Atumina mo Hebron omanima epanduvali no meya. Iya atyitilamo ovana ankho vatiwa o Amnon, na Abesalau na Adonia.

Etyi omuvo wehikapo, David novalume vae avaende okuka-​lwisa epundaumbo limue eewa litiwa o Jelusalei, avelitambula. Joabe, omona omukuavo wa Zeruia omphange ya David, ankho oe ukahi komutue wovita ovio. Moluotyo, David emulingi onkhalamutue yomasualali ae. Iya David pahe ahimbika okutumina mo Jelusalei.1 Samuel 26:1-25; 27:1-7; 31:1-6; 2 Samuel 1:26; 3:1-21; 5:1-10; 1 Crônicas 11:1-9. Omapulo

ETYI David ahimbika okutumina mo Jelusalei, Yehova wakuatesako omasualali ae okufinda onondyale mbavo, ovikando ovinyingi. Yehova ankho walaele okuavela ova Isilayeli otyilongo tyo Kanaa. Ngotyo, nekuateso lia Yehova otyilongo atyiho, atyilingi tyavo.

David ankho omutumini umue omuwa. Ankho uhole Yehova. Ngotyo, etyi David atambula o Jelusalei, otyipuka atetekela okulinga, okueta otyikasa tyomphango tya Yehova mo Jelusalei. Iya ahande okutunga ondyuo ya Huku opo apakemo otyikasa otyo tya Yehova.

Etyi David alinga omukulu, walinga otyipuka tyimue otyivi unene. David ankho utyii okuti tyapenga okupola otyipuka tyamuene. Mahi, onthiki imue kokangulohi, ankho ukahi nokuendaenda mombala yae. Iya amono omukai umue omuwa unene. Enyina liomukai oo, o Bateseba. Omulume wae ankho esualali lia David, litiwa o Uria.

David ankho wahanda unene Bateseba, atumu okumueta mombala yae. Omulume womukai oo, ankho ukahi kovita. Iya David alangalapo na Bateseba. Konyima Bateseba weliiva okuti omunthimba. Otyo atyisukalalesa unene David. Iya atumu omukanda ku Joabe onkhalamutue yomasualali ae, opo apake Uria komutue wovita ovinene opo aipawe. Etyi Uria ankhia, David anepe Bateseba.

Yehova anumana unene na David. Moluotyo, watuma omuumbili wae Natã akapopile David kombinga yonkhali oyo. Natã oyou tala ukahi nokupopia na David. David elivele unene mokonda yonkhali oyo alinga. Moluotyo, Yehova kemuipaele. Mahi, Yehova ati: ‘Mokonda yotyipuka otyo otyivi walinga, mokakala novitateka ovinyingi meumbo liove.’ Iya David akala tyili novitateka ovinene.

Tete, omona wavo na Bateseba wankhia. Konyima yotyo, otyiveli tya David Amnon, wakuata omphange yae Tamar kononkhono, alangalapo nae. Omona omukuavo wa David Abesalau, anumana unene mokonda yetyi tyalinga Amnon, iya emuipaa. Konyima Abesalau apandua novanthu ovanyingi, iya elipake kouhamba. Mahi, Abesalau aipawa movilwa ankho akatulila tate yae. Iya David afindi ngotyo ovita ovio. Enga, David wapita mononkhumbi ononyingi.

Mokuenda kuatyiho otyo, Bateseba atyiti omona omulume utiwa o Salomau. Etyi David akulupa, ankho ukahi nokuvela, iya omona wae Adonia elipake kouhamba. Mahi, David atumu o saserdote ankho utiwa o Zadoke, apake omulela pomutwe wa Salomau. Okulekesa okuti o Salomau malingi ohamba. Etyi pakala katutu David ankhi. Ankho una omanima 70. Watumina omanima 40. Mahi, pahe Salomau alingi ohamba yova Isilayeli.2 Samuel 11:1-27; 12:1-18; 1 Reis 1:1-48. Omapulo

ETYI Salomau alinga ohamba ankho omukuendye omututu. Mahi, Salomau ankho uhole Yehova. Moluotyo, waendela monondonga onongwa apelwe na tate yae David. Yehova ahambukilwa unene Salomau. Ngotyo, onthiki imue kounthiki, Yehova watolela Salomau kondyoi okuti: ‘Salomau, oityi uhanda ndyikuavele?’

Salomau akumbulula okuti: ‘Yehova Huku yange, ame ndyi-​mukuendye omututu, hityii oñgeni mandyitumina. Ngotyo, ndyavele ounongo opo ndyityivile okutumina ovanthu vove nonkhalelo yaviuka.’

Yehova ahambukwa unene netyi Salomau aita. Moluotyo, Yehova ati: ‘Mokonda waita ounongo, kuaitile omuenyo omule nemona, ame mandyikupe ounongo omunyingi, wehenekale nomunthu nawike. Mahi, tupu madyikuavela ovipuka wahaitile, emona nenkhimano.’

Konyima yotyo, ovakai vevali veya ku Salomau notyitateka tyimue otyinene. Omukai umue wahangununa okuti: ‘Omukai ou naame, tukala mondyuo ike. Ame natyita omona omulume. Etyi papita ononthiki onombali, mukuetu nae atyiti omona omulume. Onthiki imue kounthiki, omona wae wankhia. Putyina ame ndyilele, mukuetu wayombeleka omona wae wokuankhia ponthele yange, iya apolopo wange. Etyi napahukapo okutala omona wankhia. Okumutala nawa omona hawangeko.’

Omukai omukuavo ati: ‘Au! omona wokuna omuenyo o wange, wankhia o wae.’ Omukai wotete akumbulula okuti: ‘Au! Omona wokuankhia o wove, wokuna omuenyo o wange.’ Ankho ongotyo ovakai ovo vekahi nokulipatana. Pahe Salomau malingi ñgeni?

Salomau watuma okueta omutunga, ati: ‘Tetei pokati omona wokuna omuenyo, amuavela kese umue otyinthimbu tyae.’ Ina yotyotyili yomona oo, eliyavela okuti: ‘Mbambavo, wahaipae omona. Mupei vala mukuetu.’ Mahi, omukai omukuavo ati: ‘Enga, mutetei pokati muhemupei nawike.’

Okuhulako Salomau ati: ‘Wahaipae omona. Muavela omukai wotete. Mokonda oe ina yotyotyili.’ Salomau ankho utyii okuti ina yotyotyili una oluembia olunene nomona wae. Mokonda ankho kahande aipawe, watavela omona apewe mukuavo. Etyi ovanthu vetyiiva oñgeni Salomau atetulula otyitateka otyo, avahambukwa unene. Mokonda ankho vena ohamba omunongo.

Mokuenda kuoutumini wa Salomau, ankho Huku waavela ovanthu ononkhano onongwa. Ankho vena ovilia ovinyingi, no tiliku, no sevata, no nouva, nomakuyu, no vikuavo vali. Ovanthu ankho vavala ovikutu oviwa. Tupu ankho vakala monondyuo onongwa. Ankho kuna ovipuka oviwa, vituuka pala ovanthu aveho.1 Reis 3:3-28; 4:29-34. Omapulo

ETYI nkhele David ehenenkhie, watolela Salomau oñgeni ondyuo ya Yehova ina yokutungwa. Menima liakuana lioutumini wae, Salomau ahimbika okutunga ondyuo ya Huku. Yatungwa omanima epanduvali nomeya, iya aipu. Yatungwa novanthu ovanyingi. Tupu yapesela onombongo ononyingi unene. Mokonda yatungwa no olu onyingi, no palata onyingi.

Ondyuo oyo ya Huku, ankho yatetwa onondyuo mokati. Ankho ina onondyuo onombali mbakolela, nga mbuna ankho mbukahi mekaka lia Huku (tabernáculo). Mahi, onondyuo ombu ankho ononene vali, tyipona mbuna mbekaka. Salomau watuma okupaka otyikasa tyomphango tya Huku, mondyuo yakolela vali. Iya ovipuka ovikuavo ankho vikala mekaka lia Huku, evipake mondyuo onkhuavo mokati kondyuo ya Huku.

Etyi ondyuo ya Huku yapwa okutungwa, kualingwa otyipito tyimue otyinene. Salomau watuika konongolo elikuambela ngetyi weete polutalatu apa. Salomau wapopila Yehova okuti: ‘Eulu heneneko opo ufuemo. Pahe mondyuo ei onthutu mofumo ñgeni? Mahi, Huku yange mbambavo tehelela ovanthu vove putyina velikuambela mondyuo ino.’

Etyi Salomau amana okulikuambela, peulu patunda otupia, atuyoko ovinyama viotyilikutila ankho viapongiywa. Ondyuo ya Huku, aiho aiyula otyitei tya Yehova. Otyo tyalekesa okuti Yehova ankho ukahi nokutehelela. Ankho wahambukua nondyuo oyo ikola, nelikuambelo lia Salomau. Ngotyo, ondyuo oyo ya Huku yalinga omphangu omu ovanthu ankho veya okufendela. Salomau watumina nounongo omanima omanyingi. Moluotyo, ovanthu ankho vena ehambu enene. Anthi, Salomau wahimbika okunepa ovakai ovanyingi vovilongo ovikuavo, viahafende Yehova. Tala omukai umue ukahi nokufenda otyilolo polutalatu olu? Okuhulako ovakai va Salomau, vemuyapula, ahimbika oku-​fenda ono huku ononkhuavo. Utyii oityi tyapitapo, etyi Salomau alinga ngotyo? Ankho katekula vali ovanthu noluembia. Walinga ondingavivi, iya ovanthu ankho vetupu vali ehambu.

Yehova anumana unene na Salomau, iya emupopila okuti: ‘Ame mandyikupolo ouhamba, andyiuavela omunthu omukuavo. Himetyilingi pononthiki mbove. Mandyityilingi mouhamba womona wove. Mahi, himapolo ovanthu aveho mouhamba womona wove.’ Tutalei oñgeni otyo tyaenda.1 Crônicas 28:9-21; 29:1-9; 1 Reis 5:1-18; 2 Crônicas 6:12-42; 7:1-5; 1 Reis 11:9-13. Omapulo

OVE utyii omokonda yatyi omulume ou ekahi nokutandulila otyikutu tyae ovinthimbu? O Yehova wemutuma. Omulume ou o Aija omuuli wa Huku. Okuti utyii oityi omuuli? Omuuli omunthu una Huku atetekela okupopila ovipuka mavikapita komutwe.

Aija ukahi apa nokupopia na Jeroboau. Jeroboau omulume umue ankho Salomau apakele komutue wovilinga viokutunga onondyuo mbae. Etyi Aija ahonyena apa na Jeroboau metapalo, walinga otyipuka etyi uluete polutalatu olu. Wapola otyikutu tyae otyipe ankho avala, etyitandaula ovinthimbu 12. Iya apopila Jeroboau okuti: ‘Tambula ovinthimbu 10 pala ove.’ Utyii omokonda yatyi Aija apela Jeroboau ovinthimbu 10?

Aija wahangununa okuti Yehova mapolo ouhamba pomaoko a Salomau. Wati Yehova maavela Jeroboau omihoko 10. Otyo ankho tyilekesa okuti omona wa Salomau Roboau, matumina vala omihoko vivali.

Etyi Salomau eiva etyi Aija atolela Jeroboau, anumana unene. Aovola okuipaa Jeroboau. Mahi, Jeroboau atilila ko Egitu. Konyima Salomau ankhi. Watumina omanima 40. Iya pahe omona wae Roboau alingi ohamba. Ko Egitu Jeroboau wetyiiva okuti Salomau wankhia. Iya Jeroboau akondoka ko Isilayeli.

Roboau ankho ohamba imue ombi. Ankho ulinga ovanthu omapita unene tyipona tate yae Salomau. Moluotyo, Jeroboau no valume vamue ovanene mo Isilayeli, avaende ko Hamba Roboau. Okukemuita opo atekule nawa ovanthu. Mahi, Roboau katavelele. Nkhele koundingavivi wae ayauisako vali. Moluotyo, ovanthu avalingi Jeroboau ohamba yomihoko 10. Iya omuhoko wa Benjamim nowa Judaa avitualako okutuminwa na Roboau.

Jeroboau ankho kahandele ovanthu vakafendele Yehova kondyuo yae ko Jelusalei. Moluotyo, walinga ononthane onombali mbo olu, opo ovanthu vomihoko 10 vembufende. Mononthiki mbehehi, otyilongo atyiyula oungangala.

Tupu, mouhamba womihoko vivali ankho muna ovitateka ovinyingi. Etyi Roboau alinga ohamba, papita vala omanima ehehi iya ohamba yoko Egitu aiya okulwisa o Jelusalei. Aityindi emona enyingi mondyuo ya Yehova. Ngotyo, ondyuo ya Yehova yakalele vala tyefiwa omanima ehehi.1 Reis 11:26-43; 12:1-33; 14:21-31. Omapulo

KONYIMA yononkhia mbohamba Jeroboau, onohamba ambuho mbatumina omihoko 10 vio Isilayeli, ankho onondingavivi. Ohamba Akabe ankho ondingavivi vali unene tyipona onohamba ambuho. Ove utyii omokonda yatyi? Ehunga limue enene, omokonda yomukai wae, ondingavivi Jezabele.

Jezabele ankho hamu Isilayeli ko. Ankho omona wohamba yoko Sidon. Jezabele ankho ufenda Mbaale, o huku yomatutu. Iya ayapula Akabe nova Isilayeli ovanyingi, navo avahimbika okufenda Mbaale. Jezabele ankho uyele Yehova. Moluotyo, waipaa ovauli ovanyingi va Yehova. Iya ovakuavo avakaholama momaleva opo vahaipawe. Putyina ankho Jezabele ahanda otyipuka tyimue, wipaa muene watyo, iya otyipuka otyo atyilingi tyae.

Onthiki imue Ohamba Akabe ankho wanumana unene. Iya Jezabele emupulu okuti; ‘Omokonda yatyi wanumanena hono?’

Akabe emukumbulula okuti: ‘Omokonda yetyi tyantholela Nabote. Ame ankho nahanda okulanda eepia liae. Iya oe wamphopila okuti katyitavela.’

Jezabele emupopila okuti: ‘Wahasukalale malilingi liove, ame mandyityivili.’

Iya, Jezabele ahonekela omikanda kononkhalamutue mbepundaumbo ankho mukala Nabote. Ati: ‘Taindyei ovanthu vamue vahasilivila, opo vatendeleye Nabote okuti wahingana Huku nohamba.’ Iya amutuala Nabote kondye yepundaumbo, amumuipaa nomamanya.’

Etyi Jezabele etyiiva okuti Nabote wankhia, atolela Akabe okuti: ‘Pahe enda eepia lia Nabote o liove.’ Jezabele katokalele okuhitiswa mokonda yotyipuka otyo otyivi alinga?

Moluotyo, Yehova konyima watuma Jeú opo akahitise Jezabele. Etyi Jezabele eiva okuti Jeú ukahi nokuiya, elivaleka nawa, nokulipindala komaiho no komulungu okulihiwisa nawa. Mahi, Jeú etyi ehika, wamonena Jezabele pondyanena, iya aihana ovalume ankho vekahi kombala yae kosapalalo ati: ‘Yumbei Jezabele pohi.’ Iya ovalume ovo avetavela, ngetyi weete polutalatu apa. Avemuyumbu pohi okutunda kosapalalo, iya Jezabele ankhi. Eli, olio ehulilo lia Jezabele Onkhai-hamba yondingavivi.1 Reis 16:29-33; 18:1-4; 21:1-16; 2 Reis 9:30-37. Omapulo

OVE utyii ovalie ovalume ava? Utyii oityi vekahi nokulinga? Vekahi nokuenda kovita. Iya ovalume veli komutue, vekahi nokuimba. Mahi, ove upondola okupula okuti: ‘Omokonda yatyi ovanthu ava vekahi nokuimba vahatyindile omitunga no maonga okukalwa? Tutalei.

Jeosafa ankho ohamba yomihoko vivali vio Isilayeli, pomuvo wa Jezabele na Akabe Ohamba yomihoko 10 vio Isilayeli. Mahi, Jeosafa ankho ohamba imue ongwa. Tupu Asa, tate ya Jeosafa ankho wali ohamba ongwa. Moluotyo, ovanthu vomihoko vivali, ankho vena omuenyo omuwa.

Mahi, ankho pena otyipuka tyimue tyaetesa ovanthu ouoma. Jeosafa watolelua okuti: ‘Omafualali omanyingi oko Moabe, noko Amom no Komphunda yo Seir, ekahi nokuiya okukulwisa.’ Moluotyo, ova Isilayeli ovanyingi veliongiya mo Jelusalei, okuovola ekuateso ku Yehova. Avaende kondyuo ya Huku, iya Jeosafa elikuambela okuti: ‘Yehova Huku yetu, onthue katutyii oityi matulingi. Tutupu epondolo liokulwisa omafualali omanyingi ngoo. Tukahi nokuita opo utukuateseko.’

Yehova evetehelela. Iya atumu omuumbili wae opo apopile ovanthu okuti: ‘Ovilwa evi havienyiko, ovia Huku. Onue kamamulu. Talei vala oñgeni Yehova memuyovola.’

Ngotyo, etyi kuatya Jeosafa watolela ovanthu okuti: ‘Yumbei onthumbi mu Yehova.’ Atumu ovalume vokuimba vapite komutue womasualali, opo vaende nokuimba oviimbo vinkhimaneka Yehova. Utyii oityi tyapita puetyi vehika popepi no nondyale mbavo? Yehova wapaka ondyaya pokati komafualali onondyale mbavo. Aahimbika okuliipaa oo muene. Etyi ova Isilayeli vehika, vavasa vala omafualali aeho onondyale mbavo ankhia.

Jeosafa kalingile onondunge, okuyumba onthumbi mu Yehova? Nonthue matukala ovanandunge, inkha tuyumba onthumbi mu Yehova.1 Reis 22:41-53; 2 Crônicas 20:1-30. Omapulo

INKHA ñgeno ove wankhia, iya opindukapo vali, me yove ukala ñgeni? Mahambukwa unene. Mahi, omunthu wankhia upondola okupindukapo vali? Okuti lumue tyamonekeliale?

Tala omulume ou, nomukai ou, no kamukuendye aka polutalatu apa. Omulume ou, omuuli wa Huku utiwa o Elia. Omukai ou omuhepe woko Salefa, iya okamukuendye aka omona wae. Onthiki imue omona ou wavela. Watualako nokuvela unene alo ankhia. Iya Elia apopila omukai ou okuti: ‘Eta kuno omona.’

Elia watyinda omona oo aede nae mondyuo yae, emulangeka koula. Elikuambela okuti: ‘Yehova mbambavo pindulapo omona ou.’ Iya omona ahimbika okufuima. Elia emukondola ku me yae, emupopila okuti: ‘Tala omona wove una omuenyo.’ Otyo me yae ahambukilwa unene.

Omuuli omukuavo wa Yehova ankho wakolela, o Eliseu. Eliseu ankho omukuatesiko wa Elia. Tupu Yehova waundapesa Eliseu pala okulinga omahuviso. Onthiki imue, Eliseu wapita kepundaumbo lio Sunei, avasiko omukai umue walekesa Eliseu onkhenda onene. Konyima omukai oo akutula okamukuendye.

Onthiki imue etyi omona oo ekula, walandula tate yae ankho ukahi nokuundapa kepia. Iya oko omona ahimbika okuliyavela okuti: ‘Omutwe wange wihama.’ Iya emutuala keumbo. Konyima omona ankhi. Me yae anumana unene. Mahi, akanyauka okukaihana Eliseu.

Etyi Eliseu ehika, wanyingila mondyuo ankho mukahi omona oo wankhia. Elikuambela ku Yehova, iya alangala kombanda yomona oo wokuankhia. Olutu luomona aluhimbika okutokota, iya omona atu ononthesi ovikando epanduvali. Etyi me yae eya wavasa omona wae una omuenyo, ahambukwa unene.

Otyinyingi tyovanthu tyankhia. Otyo tyanumanesa unene onombunga mbavo, no mapanga avo. Onthue tutupu epondolo liokupindulapo ovanthu vokuankhia. Mahi, Yehova una epondolo. Komutue matukelilongesa oñgeni, Yehova makapindulapo ovanthu ovanyingi vokuankhia.1 Reis 17:8-24; 2 Reis 4:8-37. Omapulo

OVE utyii oityi omukainthu ou ekahi nokupopia? Ukahi nokutolela omukai ou, kombinga ya Eliseu omuuli wa Yehova. No kombinga yovipuka vihuvisa Eliseu alinga nekuateso lia Yehova. Omukai ou kei natyike kombinga ya Yehova, mokonda hamu Isilayeli ko. Mahi, tutalei oñgeni omukainthu ou eya meumbo liomukai ou.

Omukai ou owo kotyilongo tyo Siria. Omulume wae o Naamã, onkhalamutue yomafualali o Siria. Omafualali o Siria, akuata omukainthu ou omu Isilayeli, avemueta komukai wa Naamã opo alinge omuundapi wae.

Naamã ankho una ouvela umue omuvi utiwa otyilundu. Ouvela oo, unyona olutu luomunthu, nominwe uvitokesako. Ngotyo, omukainthu ou ukahi nokupopila omukai wa Naamã okuti: ‘Ame nahandele ñgeno omuhona wange wenda komuuli wa Yehova ko Isilayeli. Opo ekemuhakule otyilundu tyae.’ Iya avetyitolela Naamã.

Naamã ankho wahanda unene okuhakulwa. Moluotyo, atokola okuenda ko Isilayeli. Etyi ehika ko Isilayeli, aende kondyuo ya Eliseu. Eliseu watuma omuundapi wae apopile Naamã okuti, kelikohe Menyana lio Jordau ovikando epanduvali. Otyo tyanumanesa unene Naamã, iya ati: ‘Omanyana o kotyilongo tyetu omawa vali tyipona kese enyana mo Isilayeli. Etyi amana okupopia onondaka ombo aende.

Mahi, omuundapi umue apopila Naamã okuti: ‘Tatekulu, inkha Eliseu ekutumine okulinga otyipuka tyimue tyepuiya, ñgeno wetyilinga. Omokonda yatyi kukelikohela vala ngetyi Eliseu apopia?’ Naamã etavela komuundapi wae, aende okukanyingila onthuitwi mo Jordau ovikando epanduvali. Etyi atundamo ohitu yae aiho ikahi nawa, waveluka.

Naamã ahambukwa unene. Akondoka ku Eliseu, emupopila okuti: ‘Pahe ndyityii nawa okuti Huku yova Isilayeli, oe vala Huku yotyotyili ouye auho. Moluotyo, mbambavo tambula otyiawa etyi nekuetela.’ Mahi, Eliseu akumbulula okuti: ‘Au, ame himatambula.’ Eliseu ankho utyii okuti tyapenga okutambula ofeto, mokonda o Yehova wavelula Naamã. Mahi, Geazi omuundapi wa Eliseu, ankho uhanda ovipuka ovio.

Moluotyo etyi Naamã apita, Geazi wahatekela monyima yae, ati: Eliseu wanthuma umuavele oviawa vimue, pala ovaenda vae veya okumutalelapo.’ Otyo ankho ounkhembi. Mahi, Naamã ankho ketyii okuti ounkhembi. Iya emuavela.

Etyi Geazi akondoka keumbo, Eliseu ankho utyiiale etyi akalingile. Mokonda ankho Yehova wemutolelatyo. Moluotyo Eliseu apopila Geazi okuti: ‘Mokonda yotyipuka otyo otyivi walinga, pahe mokala notyilundu tya Naamã.’ Iya liwa liwa akala notyilundu.

Oityi tupondola okulilongesila kuotyo atyiho? Tete, tyitulongesa okuti tuna yokulinga ngomukainthu oo, okupopila ovanthu kombinga ya Yehova. Mokonda otyo tyipondola okukuatesako ovanthu. Vali, katupondola okukala nomalityindailo nga Naamã potete. Mahi, tuna yokutavela kovaumbili va Huku. Tatu, katupondola okukemba ngetyi tyalingile Geazi. Okutanga Ombimbiliya katyitulongesa ovipuka ovinyingi?2 Reis 5:1-27. Omapulo

TALA omulume ou momeva. Ukahi movitateka ovinene, hatyoko? Ombisi ei maimunyinipo. Utyii olie omulume ou? Enyina liae o Jona. Tutalei oñgeni elipaka movitateka evi ovinene.

Jona omuuli wa Yehova. Konyima yononkhia mba Eliseu, papita vala omuvo wehehi, iya Yehova atolela Jona okuti: ‘Enda kepundaumbo enene lio Ninive. Ouvi wovanthu ovo walinga omunene. Nahanda wende ukevepopile tyo.’

Jona ankho kahandele okuenda. Moluotyo, walonda mowato umue ankho wenda kotyilongo tyimue tyikala kokule unene no Ninive. Yehova kahambukilwe mokonda ankho Jona ukahi nokutila. Iya Yehova apindula epukupuku limue enene, iya owato auhande okunyingila kohi yomeva. Ovaendesi vowato avakala unene nouoma, avahimbika okuita ekuateso kono huku mbavo. Okuhulako Jona evetolela okuti: ‘Ame ndyifenda Yehova, Huku walinga eulu noohi. Ndyikahi nokutila ovilinga natumwa na Yehova.’ Iya ovaendesi vowato avemupulu okuti: ‘Oityi tuna yokulinga opo epukupuku eli, litule?’

Jona akumbulula ati: ‘Ndyumbei melunga, opo litule.’ Anthi, ovaendesi vowato ankho kavahandele okumuyumba melunga. Mahi, etyi epukupuku lieliyawisa, avemuyumbu melunga. Iya omphepo aitulu liwa liwa, iya elunga alihiliya.

Etyi Jona anyingila kohi yomeva, wanyinuapo nombisi imue onene. Mahi, kankhile. Wakala ovitenya vitatu, no vinthiki vitatu meimo liombisi oyo. Jona elivele unene, mokonda yetyi ehetavelele ku Yehova. Utyii oityi alinga?

Jona welikuambela ku Yehova okuita ekuateso. Iya Yehova ayeke ombisi ikemuhandyele kondye yelunga keheke liakukuta. Konyima yotyo, Jona aende ko Ninive. Otyo katyitulongesa okuti tyakolela unene okulinga etyi Yehova atuma?Omukanda wa Jonas. Omapulo

OLUTALATU olu lulekesa ouye omupe, ngauna Huku alekesile omuuli wae Isaia. Isaia ankho waliko konyima yononkhia mba Jona.

Opalaisu, ‘ouye omupe’ ine ‘otyikunino.’ Omphangu ei kaiku-​hinangelesa otyipuka tyimue wamonale momukanda ou? Yelifwa unene notyikunino tyina otyiwa Yehova alingile pala Andau na Eva. Ine hatyoko? Mahi, onthiki imue oohi maikakala omphangu yombembwa?

Yehova watuma omuuli wae Isaia, opo ahoneke kombinga youye omupe ine opalaisu, yovanthu va Huku. Isaia wati: ‘Omahunyu no nongi mavikakala kumue nombembwa. Ononthane mambukalia kumue noviketa viononkheyama. Iya avikaliswa nokamukuendye. Olukembe inkha lukanyana nonyoka, kaikemulinga omapita.’

Ovanthu ovanyingi vati: ‘Otyo katyivilwa. Mokonda apeho kombanda yoohi kuna vala ononkhumbi. Iya ononkhumbi ombu mambukakalako apeho.’ Pahe nkhele sokolola: Eumbo patyi Huku apele Andau na Eva?

Huku wapakele Andau na Eva mopalaisu, omphangu imue yombembwa. Vavombesa vala eumbo liavo olio eewa, mokonda kavetavelele ku Huku. Moluotyo, vakulupa iya avankhi. Mahi, Huku walaa okuti makaavela ovanthu vana vemuhole, ovipuka aviho Andau na Eva vavombesa.

Mouye omupe ine omopalaisu, natyimue matyikalingwa omapita, ine okunyonwa. Mamukakala ombembwa yotyotyili. Ovanthu aveho mavakakala nekongoko nehambu. Matyikakala ngetyi ankho Huku ahandele ponthyimbi. Matukelilongesa oñgeni Huku makaeta onkhalelo oyo.Isaías 11:6-9; Revelação 21:3, 4. Omapulo

UTYII omokonda yatyi omulume ou ekahi nokulikuambela ku Yehova? Omokonda yatyi apakela omikanda evi komutue wo altar ya Yehova? Omulume ou o Ezekia. Ezekia ankho ohamba yomihoko vivali vio Isilayeli. Ankho ukahi movitateka ovinene. Omokonda yatyi?

Omokonda omafualali oko Asiria ankho ahanyaunale omihoko 10 vio Isilayeli. Yehova wayeka vaha-​nyaunuepo mokonda ovanthu ovo ankho onondingavivi unene. Iya pahe ankho omafualali o Asiria ekahi nokuiya okuluisa ouhamba womihoko vivali.

Ohamba yo Asiria yatumikisa omikanda ko hamba Ezekia. Omikanda ovio, ovievi Ezekia apaka komutue wo altar ya Huku. Omikanda evi vilinga omukuele Yehova. Tupu vipopila Ezekia ayekepo okukolela mu Yehova. Otyo Ezekia ekahi nokulikuambelela ku Yehova okuti: ‘Mbambavo Yehova, tuyovole pomaoko ohamba yo Asiria. Opo ovanthu aveho vetyinoñgonoke okuti ove vala Huku.’ Okuti Yehova matehelela umue Ezekia?

Ezekia ankho ohamba imue ongwa. Ankho kekahi ngo nohamba onondingavivi mbomihoko 10 vio Isilayeli. Tupu ankho kekahi nga tate yae ohamba Akas. Ezekia ankho utavela nawa ovitumino aviho via Yehova. Moluotyo, etyi Ezekia amana okulikuambela, omuuli Isaia watuma okumupopila onondaka mbatunda ku Yehova okuti: ‘Ohamba, yo Asiria kamainyingila mo Jelusalei. Nawike pomafualali ae mehiki popepi no Jelusalei. Kamavayumbu omuhongo nawike mepundaumbo.’ Tala olutalatu olu peefo eli. Ove utyii oapi omafualali aa ankhia? Omafualali o Asiria. Yehova watuma oandyu yae, aiipaa 185.000 yomafualali, motyinthiki tyike vala. Ngotyo, ohamba yo Asiria yafindwa, iya aikondoka keumbo.

Ngotyo, Ouhamba womihoko vivali wayovolwa. Iya ovanthu avakala nombembwa. Etyi Ezekia ankhia, omona wae Manases alingi ohamba. Mahi, Manases nomona wae Amom, ankho ono hamba onondingavivi unene. Moluotyo, otyilongo ankho tyeyula vali oungangala. Ohamba Amom waipaua novaundapi vae. Iya omona wae Josia akala ohamba youhamba oo womihoko vivali.2 Reis 18:1-36; 19:1-37; 21:1-25. Omapulo

JOSIA ankho una vala omanima etyinana, puetyi alinga ohamba yomihoko vivali vio Isilayeli. Ankho omona unene pala okukala ohamba. Moluotyo, ovanthu vamue ovakulu, avemukuatesako okutumina otyilongo.

Etyi papita omanima epanduvali, Josia ahimbika okuovola Yehova. Okulandula onongeleka mbono hamba onongwa, nga David, na Jeosafa na Ezekia. Puetyi nkhele omukuendye, Josia walinga otyipuka tyimue ankho tyesukisa omutima wakola.

Mokuenda kuomuvo omunyingi ova Isilayeli ovanyingi, ankho valinga ovipuka ovivi unene. Ankho vafenda ono huku mbomatutu, novilolo. Moluotyo, Josia novanthu vae, avahimbika okupola enfendelo liomatutu motyilongo. Ankho ovilinga vimue ovinene, mokonda ovanthu ovanyingi ankho vafenda ono huku mbomatutu. Josia oyou apa tala novanthu vae, vekahi nokuhanyauna ovilolo.

Konyima, Josia waholovona ovalume vetatu opo vatumine ovilinga viokuviukisa ondyuo ya Yehova. Ovanthu ankho vaava onombongo. Iya onombongo ombo ambupewa ovalume ovo vetatu, opo vafete ovilinga ankho vikahi nokuundapwa mondyuo ya Huku. Puetyi ankho vekahi nokuundapa mondyuo ya Huku, Hilkia o saserdote wavasamo otyipuka tyimue tyakolela unene. Wavasa omukanda wovitumino Yehova atumine Moisesi okuhoneka. Omukanda oo ankho wavomba omanima omanyingi.

Omukanda oo aveutuala ku Josia. Iya Josia aiti vemutangeleo. Etyi Josia atehelela onondaka ombo, anoñgonoka okuti ovanthu ankho kavekahi nokuendela movitumino via Yehova. Josia anumana unene, atandula otyikutu tyae, ngetyi weete polutalatu apa. Ati: ‘Yehova wanumana noonthue. Mokonda ovo tate yetu kavaendelele movitumino viahonekwa momukanda ou.’ Josia atumu o saserdote Hilkia akatehelele oityi Yehova mevelingi. Hilkia aende okukapula komukai umue omuuli, ankho utiwa o Hulda. Iya Hulda emupopila onondaka mbatunda ku Yehova, opo Hilkia ekembutolele Josia, ati: ‘O Jelusalei novanthu vatyo aveho, mavahitiswa. Mokonda vafenda ono huku mbomatutu, pahe otyilongo atyiho tyeyula ovivi. Mahi, ehitiso olio kamaliya pononthiki mbove Josia, mokonda walinga etyi tyaviuka.2 Crônicas 34:1-28. Omapulo

TALA ovanthu ava vekahi nokulinga omukuele omukuendye ou. Utyii olie omukuendye ou? O Jeremia. Ankho omuuli umue wakolela wa Huku.

Etyi Ohamba Josia ahimbika okuhanyauna ovilolo motyilongo, konyima Yehova wapopila Jeremia akale omuuli Wae. Anthi, Jeremia ankho wasoka okuti omututu unene pala okukala omuuli. Mahi, Yehova emupopila okuti memukuatesako.

Jeremia atolela ova Isilayeli vayekepo okulinga ovipuka ovivi. Wati: Ovanthu vovilongo vafenda ono huku mbomatutu.’ Iya ova Isilayeli ovanyingi ankho vafenda ovilolo, kavafende Yehova Huku yotyotyili. Etyi Jeremia apopila ovanthu okuti Huku mevehitisa, mokonda yovivi valinga, ovo ankho vemuyola vala.

Papita omanima, iya Josia wankhia. Etyi Josia ankhia, papita onohanyi ononthatu, omona wae Jeoiakim alingi ohamba. Jeremia atualako nokupopila ovanthu okuti: ‘Inkha kamuyekepo okulinga ovivi o Jelusalei maihanyaunuapo.’ Ono saserdote mbakuata Jeremia, iya avakaluluka okuti: ‘Ove watokala okuipawa, mokonda yovipuka ukahi nokupopia.’ Konyima avapopila ovatumini vo Isilayeli okuti: ‘Jeremia una yokuipawa. Mokonda wapopia omapita epundaumbo lietu.’

Pahe Jeremia malingi ñgeni? Jeremia kakalele nouoma. Wevetolela okuti: ‘Yehova wanthuma opo ndyimupopile ovipuka evi. Inkha kamuyekepo okulinga ovipuka ovivi momuenyo wenyi, Yehova mahanyaunapo o Jelusalei. Mahi, noñgonokei okuti: Inkha mundyipaa, mamuipaa omunthu wahalingile natyimue tyapenga.’

Ovatumini avayeke Jeremia nomuenyo. Mahi, ova Isilayeli kavayekelepo okulinga ovipuka ovivi. Konyima Nambukondonosole ohamba yo Mbambilonia, eya okulwisa o Jelusalei. Atyindi ova Isilayeli ovanyingi opo valinge ovapika vae ko Mbambilonia. Pahe soka ñgeno ovanthu wehei, vekupola meumbo liove avekutuala kotyilongo wehei, ukala ñgeni?Jeremias 1:1-8; 10:1-5; 26:1-16; 2 Reis 24:1-17. Omapulo

OHAMBA Nambukondonosole ankho watyindile Ovaisilayeli aveho vokuatanga nawa, evetuala ko Mbambilonia. Iya ohamba aholovonapo ovakuendye vana ankho ovawa unene, novanongo. Ovakuendye vamue vekuana, ovava weete polutalatu apa. Umue utiwa o Daniele. Ovakuavo valukwa omanyina oko Mbambilonia Sadrake, na Mesake na Abedeneku.

Nambukodonosole ankho wasokele okulongesa ovakuendye ovo, opo vaundape mombala yae. Iya tyina papita omanima etatu, na aholovonepo vala ovanongo unene, opo vemukuateseko okutetulula ovitateka. Mokuenda kuelongeso ohamba ankho uhanda ovakuendye vakale nekongoko no kuapama. Moluotyo, watuma ovaundapi vae, vevepe aveho okulia kuna ohamba nombunga yae ankho valia, no vinyu.

Tala Daniele. Ove utyii oityi ekahi nokupopila Aspenas, onkhalamutue yovaundapi va Nambukondonosole? Daniele ukahi nokumutolela okuti, kahande okulia ovipuka oviwa vitunda komesa yo hamba. Mahi, Aspenas ankho wasukalala. Iya ati: ‘Ohamba watokola oityi onue muna yokulia nokunwa. Inkha kamukala nekongoko ngo vakuendye vakuenyi, ohamba ipondola okundyipaa.’

Daniele apopila omulume una watumua na Aspenas opo eveyunge, ati: ‘Mbambavo, hetekela vala ononthiki 10 okutuavela onombi, nomakovi, nomalupoyu atyiho tyomepia vala. Iya okunwa tuavele vala omeva. Konyima yononthiki ombo, otueleka novakuendye vana vekahi nokulia ovikulia viohamba. Otale ovalie vekahi vali nawa.’

Omulume oo etavela. Etyi papita ononthiki 10, Daniele nomapanga ae etatu, vakongoka vali tyipona ovakuendye ovakuavo. Moluotyo, omulume oo watualako nokuvepa onombi nomakovi, aviho viomepia. Eheveavela vali ovikulia viohamba.

Konyima yomanima etatu, ovakuendye aveho avevetuala ku Nambukondonosole. Etyi atomphola navo aveho, ohamba wamona okuti Daniele nomapanga ae etatu, ankho ovanongo vali. Moluotyo, ohamba evepe ovilinga vio kumukuatesako mombala. Tyina ohamba ankho apula Daniele, na Sadrake, na Mesake na Abedeneku, ine o putyina eveavela ovitateka viatena, ankho vetyivila vali unene, tyipona ono saserdote mbo hamba no vanongo vae.Daniel 1:1-21. Omapulo

PAPITA omanima 10 tunde etyi Nambukondonosole atyinda ova Isilayeli vokuatanga nawa okuvetuala Kombambilonia. Pahe tala etyi tyikahi nokupita polutalatu olu. O Jelusalei ikahi nokupia. Ova Isilayeli vana vahaipaelwe, vekahi nokutualwa koukonde Kombambilonia.

Hinangela okuti etyi, otyo ovauuli va Yehova valondolele okuti matyikapita, inkha ovanthu kavayekepo okulinga ovipuka ovivi. Anthi, ova Isilayeli kavatehelele ovauli ovo. Vatualeleko okufenda ono huku mbomatutu, tyipona okufenda Yehova. Moluotyo, ovanthu ankho vatokala okuhitiswa. Etyi onthue tutyii, mokonda Ezekiele omuuli wa Huku, utupopila kombinga yovipuka ovivi ankho vilingwa nova Isilayeli.

Ezekiele umwii? Omukuendye umue wapolelue mo Jelusalei no Hamba Nambukondonosole kumue na Daniele na Sadrake, na Mesake, na Abedeneku eveeta Kombambilonia. Pomuvo oo, ankho kuakambela omanima 10 opo o Jelusalei ihanyaunuepo.

Puetyi Ezekiele ekahi Kombambilonia, Yehova wemulekesa ovipuka ovivi ankho vilingwa mondyuo ya Huku, ko Jelusalei. Yehova wemulekesa ovipuka ovio nehuviso. Ezekiele ankho ukahi Mombambilonia. Mahi Yehova emuyeke atale ovipuka aviho ankho vilingwa mondyuo ya Huku. Ovipuka Ezekiele amona, ovivi unene.

Yehova wapopila Ezekiele ati: ‘Tala ovipuka ovivi ovanthu valingila mondyuo ya Huku. Tala ovimato vieyula omalutalatu ononyoka no vinyama ovikuavo. Iya tala ova Isilayeli vekahi nokuvifenda.’ Ezekiele ovipuka ovio aviho wevimona, evihoneka.

Yehova apulu Ezekiele okuti: ‘Uluete etyi ononkhalamutue mbova Isilayeli valingila pokamphengi?’ Enga, natyo Ezekiele ankho utyiete. Ankho pena ovalume 70, vafenda ono huku mbomatutu. Avati: ‘Yehova ketueete. Otyilongo wetyisapo.’

Yehova alekesa vali Ezekiele ovakai vamue, ankho veli kombundi yokokulio kuondyuo ya Huku. Ankho vaumphama, vafenda o huku yomatutu itiwa o Tamus. Tupu, ankho kuna ovalume 25, vekahi pombundi yondyuo ya Yehova. Ezekiele wevemona vapilukila koutundilo, ankho vaika omitue pohi vafenda ekumbi.

Yehova ati: ‘Ovanthu ava vetupu onthilo naame. Mokonda kavalingi vala ovipuka ovivi. Mahi, veya okuvilingila mondyuo yange!’ Moluotyo, Yehova walaa okuti: ‘Mavamono ononkhono mbonyengo yange. Himakala nokankhenda navo, putyina vahanyaunuako.’ Papita vala omanima etatu, tunde etyi Yehova alekesa Ezekiele ovipuka ovio. Iya ova Isilayeli avatyitukilapo Ohamba Nambukondonosole. Moluotyo, Nambukondonosole aende okukevelwisa. Etyi papita enima nomeya, omafualali Ombambilonia aanyingila mo Jelusalei. Epundaumbo aliho avelipake otupia, ovanthu ovanyingi avaipawa. Ovakuavo avatualwa ko Mbambilonia ngo nonkhuatwa.

Omokonda yatyi Yehova ayekela ova Isilayeli vapite mehanyauno eevi ngolio? Omokonda ova Isilayeli kavatehelele Yehova, no kutavela ovitumino viae. Otyo tyitulekesa okuti, tyakolela unene tulinge apeho etyi Huku apopia.

Potete mo Isilayeli ankho muesalele vala ovanthu vehehi. Ohamba Nambukondonosole aholovona Gedaliya, opo atumine ovanthu ovo. Anthi, ova Isilayeli vamue vaipaa Gedaliya. Pahe ovanthu avakala nouoma, wokuti voko Mbambilonia maveya okuveipaa aveho, mokonda yotyipuka otyo otyivi. Iya avakuluminya Jeremia aende navo, nkholo ko Egitu.

Moluotyo, otyilongo tyo Isilayeli tyesala tyihena omunthu nawike mokuenda kuomanima 70. Ankho nawike vali ukala motyilongo otyo. Mahi, Yehova walaa okuti konyima yomanima 70, makondola ova Isilayeli motyilongo tyavo. Anthi, puetyi nkhele omuvo oo wehenehikepo, oityi tyapita novanthu va Huku, ko Mbambilonia oko vatualwa? Tutalei.2 Reis 25:1-26; Jeremias 29:10; Ezequiel 1:1-3; 8:1-18. Omapulo
